```{r}
library(BiocManager) 
library(TCGAbiolinks) 
library(maftools)
library (knitr)
library(sesame)
library(sesameData)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Query, Download, and Prepare the data.
```{r}
query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-OV",
                  data.category = "DNA Methylation",
                  data.type = "Methylation Beta Value",
                  platform = "Illumina Human Methylation 450",
                  data.format = "Dataframe")
#GDCdownload(query)      <-- you will need to run this!
GDCdownload(query)
methylation450 <- GDCprepare(query)
```

```{r}
clin_query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-OV", 
                       data.category = "Clinical", 
                       data.type = "Clinical Supplement", 
                       data.format = 'OV Biotab') 
GDCdownload(clin_query) 
clinical.OVtab.all <- GDCprepare(clin_query) 
clinic <- clinical.OVtab.all$clinical_patient_ov[-c(1,2),]
```

```{r}
colnames(clinic)[ colnames(clinic) == "bcr_patient_barcode" ] <- 
"Tumor_Sample_Barcode" 


maf_query <- GDCquery( 
project = "TCGA-OV", 
data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation", 
access = "open", 
data.type = "Masked Somatic Mutation", 
workflow.type = "Aliquot Ensemble Somatic Variant Merging and Masking" 
)

GDCdownload(maf_query, method = "api",  files.per.chunk = 100) 
maf <- GDCprepare(maf_query) 
maf_object <- read.maf(maf = maf, 
clinicalData = clinic, 
isTCGA = TRUE)
```

```{r}
rna_query <- GDCquery(project ="TCGA-OV",
                      data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
                      data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification", 
                      workflow.type = "STAR - Counts")
GDCdownload(rna_query)
rna_se <- GDCprepare(rna_query)
```

```{r}
dim(rna_se@colData)
dim(rna_se@rowRanges@elementMetadata)
dim(rna_se@assays@data$unstranded)
```

rownames(rna_se@colData)
